So once you added a row you were stuck with it. (The \"Add another category\" button also re-ran the wiring, double-binding existing buttons.)\n\n2. **The form didn't push back on half-finished input.** `ReviewScoreCategoryForm` made a new score's *value* required but its *label* optional, and `save()` only created a score `if value is not None and label`. Net effect: a row with a value but no label was **silently dropped** (nothing saved, nothing said); other bad input surfaced only as the generic *\"We had trouble saving your input\"* banner with no pointer to the offending field.\n\n3. **Errors weren't shown where they belong, and new rows vanished on failure.** The template never rendered field-level errors for score value/label inputs, and newly-added rows weren't re-rendered after a failed submit (and the JS wiped them on load), so the banner's *\"see below for details\"* had nothing below it.\n\n## The fixes\n\n- **`orga/forms/event.py`** — new score value/label fields are no longer individually required; a `clean()` now validates **every** row (new and existing, in every category) uniformly: a fully-empty row is ignored (new) or deletes the score (existing = the clean walk-back), and a **half-finished** row raises a specific error *on the exact missing field* instead of being dropped or saved incomplete.
